notes: All Tornado ledger entries use ETH in the current ledger; BSC/Polygon/Arbitrum/OP deployment activity is separate same-address/other-chain evidence, not an additional OFAC chain designation.
Unique depositors means distinct evidenced top-level transaction origins, a lower bound on origin addresses and never a count of people. Contract callers and economic depositors can differ.
CEX-labelled origin is a direct transaction-origin label match only. One-hop CEX withdrawal funding of unlabelled depositors is unmeasured; unknown origins and unlabelled senders are not clean funds.
Pool TVL samples retain their actual observation time. USD at day close revalues that sample, not an independently observed closing balance.
Daily missing/unreadable inputs are not zero activity. Full log coverage and date assignment are separately reported.

disclaimer: Research, not legal or compliance advice. Receipt from a sanctioned address does not establish wrongdoing. Labels are leads; no controller inference.

fetch_status.meaning: provisional describes unfinished acquisition for the stated bounded study; complete describes whole-address history. Terminal privacy/provider gaps and window-only histories stay explicit exceptions. Neither false provisional nor a completed acquisition implies complete population coverage.

findings.confidence: Different time horizons: price uses explicitly timestamped November 25/27 samples, protocol use uses equal 30-day windows. Market data is not inferred from these illustrative pool transactions. Descriptive, not causal.
findings.sentence: Around Van Loon, sampled TORN price rose 458.17%; ETH deposits in the surrounding 30-day windows rose 5.06%.

findings.confidence: High for native balances at the stated blocks. Examples illustrate contemporary pool deposits, not the complete net change. This is stock, not gross flow, seized value or legal-compliance measurement.

findings.confidence: High for event counts and native ETH denominations. Denomination concentration does not identify people, ownership or the purpose of deposits.
findings.sentence: The 100 ETH pool supplied 85.11% of ETH deposited in the post-delisting 30-day window; its Deposit count rose from 102 to 385.

methods.date_assignment: Exact event/block timestamp where available; otherwise UTC date only when preceding/following exact timestamp anchors agree on UTC date. Remaining ambiguous dates excluded and counted.
methods.legal_publication_time: unknown within action date; no hour-level causal claims
methods.pool_principal: One denomination per Deposit/Withdrawal event; withdrawal principal includes any relayer fee. Never add an internal value transfer to its pool event.
methods.provisional: Bounded acquisition is complete; pinned snapshot makes --check reproducible independently of live timeline replacement.
methods.relayer_use: Nonzero indexed Withdrawal relayer field; positive relayer fee is a separate statistic; either can differ from submitting transaction sender.
